description: This file implements classes and functions related to secure user input messages within the confui namespace, including secure selection and touch messages, with utility functions to create secure message instances.

classes.name: ConfUiSecureUserSelectionMessage
classes.description: Represents a secure user selection message, encapsulating a user selection message and its security status.

classes.name: ConfUiSecureUserTouchMessage
classes.description: Represents a secure user touch message, encapsulating a user touch message and its security status.

methods.name: CheckAndReturnSessionId
methods.description: Template utility function that checks the validity of a message pointer and returns its session ID.

methods.name: ConfUiSecureUserSelectionMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing a secure user selection message with a given message and security flag.

methods.name: ConfUiSecureUserTouchMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing a secure user touch message with a given message and security flag.

methods.name: ToSecureSelectionMessage
methods.description: Factory function creating a secure user selection message from a given message and security flag.

methods.name: ToSecureTouchMessage
methods.description: Factory function creating a secure user touch message from a given message and security flag.
